ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic map of the distribution of location indices in China. The legend shows that different shadings correspond to different location index levels, among which region Jia is located along China’s eastern coast and is in a high-value area with a location index greater than 40. Then reason: The high-value area along the eastern coast is close to the coast, and the conditions for sea-land connections are relatively good. One of its prominent location advantages is convenient transportation conditions. Therefore, the blank “______ convenient” should be filled with “transportation.”
